name: NYU CTF Bench
intro: 大型语言模型（LLMs）在网络安全领域的夺旗（CTF）挑战解决能力尚未得到充分评估。为解决此问题，本研究开发了一种新颖的方法，通过创建一个可扩展的开源基准数据集来评估LLMs在CTF挑战中的表现。该基准数据集包含来自流行竞赛的各种CTF挑战，并支持LLM测试和自适应学习的元数据。通过提供专门的基准，该项目为开发、测试和完善基于LLM的漏洞检测和解决方案提供了理想平台。
build_method: CSAW 挑战收集, 人工可解性验证, Docker/文件环境标准化, JSON 元数据打包
eval_feature: 可扩展, 开源, 动态更新, 过程评估, 工具调用
build_method_en: CSAW Challenge Collection, Manual Solvability Validation, Docker/File Environment Standardization, JSON Metadata Packaging
eval_feature_en: Scalable, open source, Dynamic Update, process evaluation, tool invocation
intro_en: Large language models (LLMs) have not been fully evaluated in their ability to solve cybersecurity capture-the-flag (CTF) challenges. To address this, this study developed a novel approach by creating a scalable open-source benchmark dataset to assess LLM performance on CTF challenges. The benchmark dataset includes various CTF challenges from popular competitions and supports metadata for LLM testing and adaptive learning. By providing a dedicated benchmark, this project offers an ideal platform for developing, testing, and refining LLM-based vulnerability detection and solutions.

drawio_review_note: Primary-source review: arXiv:2406.05590v3 §§2–2.1, §3, §4, and Table 2. The archive covers 568 CSAW challenges from 2011–2023; Table 2 reports the retained 200 challenges from 2017–2023 in six categories. Manual review rechecks setup and solvability and can identify missing files caused by maintenance; it does not claim to restore them. Server and file challenges are alternative validation routes, not serial gates. Reproducible packages combine Docker Hub images, Compose, source assets, and challenge.json; only listed files and connection details are visible, while the flag remains hidden. Evaluation uses alternative server/file loaders, up to six category-tailored tools, five independent runs, exact flag comparison, and a 48-hour limit per LLM.
